mapper.select: SELECT seat_class_id, class_name, class_ratio, sort_order FROM SEAT_CLASS ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT aircraft_id, reg_no, model_name, total_seats, is_active, status_name FROM AIRCRAFT ORDER BY aircraft_id DESC

SELECT A.aircraft_id AS "aircraft_id", A.reg_no AS "reg_no", A.model_name AS "model_name", COUNT(S.seat_id) AS "total_generated" FROM AIRCRAFT A LEFT JOIN SEAT S ON A.aircraft_id = S.aircraft_id GROUP BY A.aircraft_id, A.reg_no, A.model_name ORDER BY A.aircraft_id DESC

SELECT S.seat_id, S.seat_no, S.is_active, C.class_name FROM SEAT S JOIN SEAT_CLASS C ON S.seat_class_id = C.seat_class_id WHERE S.aircraft_id = #{aircraftId} ORDER BY LENGTH(S.seat_no) ASC, S.seat_no ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FLIGHT WHERE aircraft_id = #{aircraftId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
